# Glossary

- <a id="term-bounce-buffer"></a>**Bounce buffer**: A pair of small internal RAM buffers that the RGB LCD driver fills from a framebuffer in PSRAM and sends to the pins.
- <a id="term-mda"></a>**MDA**: The IBM Monochrome Display Adapter signal: 720x350 pixels, 18.43 kHz horizontal, about 50 Hz vertical, TTL levels on a DE-9 connector.
- <a id="term-porch"></a>**Porch**: The blank pixels or lines between the end of the picture and the sync pulse (front porch) or after it (back porch).
